result.note: A state vision document with few durable facts. One question tests the plan's basic features and Chhattisgarh's origin.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about Anjor Vision 2047, a development roadmap unveiled in December 2025:
items: It was unveiled by Chief Minister Vishnu Deo Sai on the opening day of the state Assembly's winter session.
The document identifies 13 priority sectors and 10 missions.
Chhattisgarh, the state that released it, was carved out of Bihar in 2000.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong because Chhattisgarh was carved out of Madhya Pradesh in 2000, not Bihar. Sai unveiled the roadmap on 14 December 2025 while the Congress boycotted the session's opening day.
questions.source: Chhattisgarh was carved out of Madhya Pradesh in 2000.
